source: Transcribed from the R&S FPC Spectrum Analyzer User Manual (1178.4130.02 ─ 08), which documents the FPC1000, FPC1500 and their options. Commands are drawn from the manual's own per-chapter command indexes, so the set covers the spectrum, receiver, analog and digital demodulation and VNA applications; the manual marks which need an option, and the tracking generator (SOURce) is FPC1500 only. Suffixes are left as the manual writes them — <n> for a window, <m> for a marker, <t> for a trace — rather than expanded. Adopted as a rebuild in August 2026: the shipped catalog’s descriptions came from an older parser generation, and of the 326 that changed, 306 are the guide’s own sentence with a glued “Prerequisites for this command” block or other trailing material now cut at the sentence, 7 are margin hyphen breaks mended, and the remainder were read one by one — among them a shipped description that was a dotted contents line. The rebuild also restores commands the older parse missed: ABORt, the two-hundred-character CALCulate<n>:LIMit<k>:DEFine pair, the rule-generated video-bandwidth auto queries, and the parameterised spelling of the harmonic-distortion query. CALCulate<n>:MARKer<m>:AOFF? is excluded by name: the manual documents AOFF per application, one occurrence carries the event sentence out of the parser’s reach, and the query it generates is the fourth exception this catalog’s history already records. The IEEE 488.2 entries are curated, as the FSW’s and FSU’s are.
